# COBOL Relation Condition & Comparison Specification (#4712)

Part of the **cobolrt-as-a-product** epic ([#4710](https://github.com/squid-protocol/gitgalaxy/issues/4710)).
Single source of truth: [`gitgalaxy/standards/cobol/compare.py`](../../gitgalaxy/standards/cobol/compare.py).
Generated by `python -m gitgalaxy.standards.cobol regen`.

## 1. Rule Catalogue (COMPARE Family)

### `RT-CBL-COMPARE-ALL-LITERAL`

- **Title:** An item against an ALL literal: the literal repeated or cut to the item's length
- **Status:** `MATCHED`
- **IBM Reference:** cobol-lr: Figurative constants: ALL literal
- **Options:** `PROGRAM-COLLATING-SEQUENCE`
- **Register:** -
- **Description:** Literal repeated or truncated to length of other comparand, compared byte by byte.

### `RT-CBL-COMPARE-FIGURATIVE`

- **Title:** An item against a figurative constant: constant character repeated (ZERO against numeric by value)
- **Status:** `MATCHED`
- **IBM Reference:** cobol-lr: Figurative constants
- **Options:** `PROGRAM-COLLATING-SEQUENCE`
- **Register:** -
- **Description:** ZERO against numeric compares by value; other figuratives repeat byte to comparand length.

### `RT-CBL-COMPARE-FLOAT`

- **Title:** A comparison with a floating-point comparand is made in floating point
- **Status:** `MATCHED`
- **IBM Reference:** cobol-lr: Comparison of numeric operands
- **Options:** -
- **Register:** `C6`
- **Description:** Fixed-point operand converted to long HFP and compared algebraically.

### `RT-CBL-COMPARE-NONDIGIT`

- **Title:** A numeric item's value in a comparison: a zoned item holding a non-digit as the oracle compares it
- **Status:** `DIFFERS`
- **IBM Reference:** IBM documents no result; oracle uses Zoned.compareValue
- **Options:** -
- **Register:** `C11`
- **Description:** Zoned non-digit comparand evaluated through oracle signed integer calculation.

### `RT-CBL-COMPARE-NONNUMERIC`

- **Title:** Nonnumeric operands compared byte by byte, the shorter padded with spaces
- **Status:** `DIFFERS`
- **IBM Reference:** cobol-lr: Comparison of alphanumeric operands
- **Options:** `PROGRAM-COLLATING-SEQUENCE`
- **Register:** `D1`
- **Description:** Compared byte by byte in character code order or under PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE.

### `RT-CBL-COMPARE-NUMERIC`

- **Title:** Numeric operands compared by value, whatever their usage and the collating sequence
- **Status:** `MATCHED`
- **IBM Reference:** cobol-lr: Comparison of numeric operands
- **Options:** -
- **Register:** -
- **Description:** Algebraic comparison by value; usage (display, packed, binary) and collating sequence ignored.

### `RT-CBL-COMPARE-NUMERIC-WITH-NONNUMERIC`

- **Title:** A numeric item against a nonnumeric one is its digits as characters, the sign dropped
- **Status:** `MATCHED`
- **IBM Reference:** cobol-lr: General relation conditions: Alphanumeric comparisons
- **Options:** -
- **Register:** `C13`
- **Description:** Numeric item treated as if moved to alphanumeric of as many characters as digits, sign dropped.

### `RT-NUM-NONDIGIT-COMPARE`

- **Title:** A zoned comparand holding a non-digit: every digit position counts in a signed 64-bit integer
- **Status:** `DIFFERS`
- **IBM Reference:** Oracle GnuCOBOL cob_cmp_numdisp behavior
- **Options:** `NUMPROC`
- **Register:** `C11`
- **Description:** NUM runtime rule evaluating dirty zoned digits in numeric comparison.

## 3. Deterministic Test Vectors

| Vector ID | Title | Rule Verified | Expected Result | Note |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `CP01-numeric-equal-different-scale` | Numeric operands with different scales compare by value | `RT-CBL-COMPARE-NUMERIC` | `0` | 12.30 equals 12.3 algebraically |
| `CP02-numeric-signed-less` | Negative numeric compares less than positive | `RT-CBL-COMPARE-NUMERIC` | `-1` | -5 < 5 |
| `CP03-nonnumeric-equal-space-pad` | Alphanumeric shorter operand padded with spaces | `RT-CBL-COMPARE-NONNUMERIC` | `0` | 'ABC' pads to 'ABC  ', equal |
| `CP04-nonnumeric-lexicographic` | Alphanumeric lexicographic byte ordering | `RT-CBL-COMPARE-NONNUMERIC` | `-1` | 'ABC' < 'ABD' |
| `CP05-numeric-with-nonnumeric-digits` | Numeric against alphanumeric compares unsigned digits | `RT-CBL-COMPARE-NUMERIC-WITH-NONNUMERIC` | `0` | 123 as digits matches '123' |
| `CP06-numeric-signed-with-nonnumeric-unpunched` | Signed numeric against alphanumeric de-punches sign | `RT-CBL-COMPARE-NUMERIC-WITH-NONNUMERIC` | `0` | Sign is dropped; digits '012' compared against '012' |
| `CP07-all-literal-comparison` | Comparison against ALL literal repeats pattern | `RT-CBL-COMPARE-ALL-LITERAL` | `0` | ALL 'XY' repeated to length 4 gives 'XYXY' |
| `CP08-figurative-spaces-comparison` | Comparison against SPACES figurative constant | `RT-CBL-COMPARE-FIGURATIVE` | `0` | All spaces matches SPACES |
